- `GET /schemas/fields/{version}` — The field catalogue, on the identity domain
- `GET /schemas/fields/{version}/{name}` — One field's JSON Schema (`{id}.json`)
- `GET /schemas/credentials/{version}` — The credential type catalogue, on the identity domain
- `GET /schemas/credentials/{version}/{name}` — The JSON Schema of a credential type's claims (`{id}.json`; a tenant's own, `{tenant_slug}/{key}.json`)
- `GET /.well-known/vct/{path}` — SD-JWT VC Type Metadata of a credential type of the identity domain: Almena's (`credentials/{key}/v1`) or a tenant's own (`credentials/{tenant_slug}/{key}/v1`)
- `GET /api/v1/catalog/fields` — The field catalogue: its fields, groups and value domains
- `GET /api/v1/catalog/credentials` — The credential type catalogue: its types and their claims
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/fields` — The tenant's own fields (the anchor's: everyone's), newest first
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/fields` — Add a field of the tenant's own to its catalogue
- `PATCH /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/fields/{field_id}` — Change one of the tenant's own fields (the anchor's: everyone's); never its key
- `DELETE /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/fields/{field_id}` — Delete one of the tenant's own fields, unless a form uses it
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/credential-types` — The credential types the tenant keeps (the anchor's: everyone's)
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/credential-types` — Add a credential type: to Almena's catalogue (the anchor), or of the tenant's own
- `PATCH /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/credential-types/{type_id}` — Change one of the tenant's credential types (the anchor's: Almena's); never its key
- `DELETE /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/credential-types/{type_id}` — Delete one of the tenant's credential types, unless something uses it
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/categories` — The trust anchor's categories, in the catalogue's order
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/categories` — Add a category to Almena's catalogue (the trust anchor only)
- `PATCH /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/categories/{category_id}` — Rename a category or change its icon (the trust anchor only); never its kind or key
- `DELETE /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/categories/{category_id}` — Delete a category nothing is filed under (the trust anchor only)
- `GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/value-domains` — The trust anchor's value domains, in the catalogue's order
- `POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/value-domains` — Add a value domain to Almena's catalogue (the trust anchor only)
- `PATCH /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/value-domains/{domain_id}` — Change a value domain (the trust anchor only); never its key
- `DELETE /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/value-domains/{domain_id}` — Delete a value domain no field draws on (the trust anchor only)

## Add a field of the tenant's own to its catalogue

`POST /api/v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/fields` · needs `Authorization: Bearer`

| Parameter | In | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tenant_id` | path | string (uuid) |  |

**Body** (`application/json`): [CustomFieldIn](/reference/api/schemas/#customfieldin)

| Field | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | string | max length 64 |
| `type` | `text`, `email`, `phone`, `date`, `code`, `codes`, `file`, `group` |  |
| `labels` | map of string |  |
| `max_length` *(optional)* | integer or null | ≥ 1, ≤ 10000 |
| `pattern` *(optional)* | string or null | max length 500 |
| `options` *(optional)* | array of [OptionIn](/reference/api/schemas/#optionin) or null | at most 300 |
| `formats` *(optional)* | array of string or null | at most 50 |
| `domain` *(optional)* | string or null | max length 64 |
| `parts` *(optional)* | array of [PartIn](/reference/api/schemas/#partin) or null | at most 20 |
| `category` *(optional)* | string or null | max length 32 |
| `source` *(optional)* | string or null | max length 200 |

| Status | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | [CustomFieldOut](/reference/api/schemas/#customfieldout) |
| 403 | [`subscription_required`](/reference/errors/#subscription_required) |
| 409 | [`key_exists`](/reference/errors/#key_exists): the tenant has it already |
| 422 | [`key_invalid`](/reference/errors/#key_invalid), [`key_reserved`](/reference/errors/#key_reserved) (one of the anchor's), [`labels_required`](/reference/errors/#labels_required) (the anchor's: every language), [`constraint_invalid`](/reference/errors/#constraint_invalid), [`pattern_invalid`](/reference/errors/#pattern_invalid), [`options_invalid`](/reference/errors/#options_invalid), [`formats_invalid`](/reference/errors/#formats_invalid), [`domain_invalid`](/reference/errors/#domain_invalid) (not one of the anchor's value domains, or with options), [`parts_invalid`](/reference/errors/#parts_invalid) (a group's: none, a key twice, not labelled in every language), [`category_invalid`](/reference/errors/#category_invalid) or [`source_required`](/reference/errors/#source_required) (the anchor's), or [`anchor_only`](/reference/errors/#anchor_only) (a category, a source or a group from another tenant) |
